LanguageData.MI_DR_TransitionReady:
More Injuries now provides delayed vital failure, neurological damage and artificial coma. Existing Death Rattle conditions and supported treatment bills have been migrated. More Injuries takes priority while both mods are active.

Save under a NEW name, keeping your original save as a backup. After the save finishes without a transition error, quit, disable Death Rattle, restart and load the new save. More Injuries validates the saved copy before removing Death Rattle from its dependency metadata.

This notification is shown once per saved game. Do not remove More Injuries from the migrated save.
